entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:2
segments: ¶THE SHULAMITE Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth-For your love [is] better than wine.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:3
segments: Because of the fragrance of your good ointments, Your name [is] ointment poured forth; Therefore the virgins love you.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:4
segments: Draw me away! THE DAUGHTERS OF JERUSALEM We will run after you. THE SHULAMITE The king has brought me into his chambers. THE DAUGHTERS OF JERUSALEM We will be glad and rejoice in you. We will remember your love more than wine. THE SHULAMITE Rightly do they love you.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:5
segments: I [am] dark, but lovely, O daughters of Jerusalem, Like the tents of Kedar, Like the curtains of Solomon.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:6
segments: Do not look upon me, because I [am] dark, Because the sun has tanned me. My mother's sons were angry with me; They made me the keeper of the vineyards, [But] my own vineyard I have not kept.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:7
segments: ¶(TO HER BELOVED) Tell me, O you whom I love, Where you feed [your flock], Where you make [it] rest at noon. For why should I be as one who veils herself By the flocks of your companions?

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:8
segments: THE BELOVED If you do not know, O fairest among women, Follow in the footsteps of the flock, And feed your little goats Beside the shepherds' tents.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:9
segments: I have compared you, my love, To my filly among Pharaoh's chariots.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:10
segments: Your cheeks are lovely with ornaments, Your neck with chains [of gold].

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:11
segments: THE DAUGHTERS OF JERUSALEM We will make you ornaments of gold With studs of silver.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:12
segments: ¶THE SHULAMITE While the king [is] at his table, My spikenard sends forth its fragrance.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:13
segments: A bundle of myrrh [is] my beloved to me, That lies all night between my breasts.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:14
segments: My beloved [is] to me a cluster of henna [blooms] In the vineyards of En Gedi.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:15
segments: THE BELOVED Behold, you [are] fair, my love! Behold, you [are] fair! You [have] dove's eyes.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:16
segments: THE SHULAMITE Behold, you [are] handsome, my beloved! Yes, pleasant! Also our bed [is] green.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:17
segments: The beams of our houses [are] cedar, [And] our rafters of fir.
